test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: "SAMYUKTA' is an electronic war programme that was developed in India jointly by _______ and the Indian Army.
solution:
The correct answer is **DRDO**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SAMYUKTA** is an electronic warfare program developed by India.
 
• This program was developed jointly by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** and the Indian Army.
 
• The system is designed to provide comprehensive electronic support to the Indian Army in various operational scenarios.
 
• **DRDO** is a premier research and development organization under the Ministry of Defence, India.
 
• The program enhances the capability of the Indian Army to carry out electronic warfare operations effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Component
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **DRDO**
 A premier research and development organization under the Ministry of Defence, India.
 
 

 **Electronic Warfare**
 Military action involving the use of electromagnetic energy to determine, exploit, reduce, or prevent hostile use of the electromagnetic spectrum.
 
 

 **SAMYUKTA**
 An electronic warfare system developed to provide comprehensive electronic support to the Indian Army.
 
 

 **Indian Army**
 The land-based branch and the largest component of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
 

 **Ministry of Defence**
 The government department responsible for implementing the defense policy set by the Government of India.
